abstract: Paraffin sections from 30 endodermal sinus (yolk sac) tumors were Feulgen-stained, and nuclear DNA content (ploidy) was assessed through DNA cytophotometry using the microTICAS image analysis system. The series consisted of 20 ovarian, 8 testicular, 1 sacrococcygeal, and 1 mediastinal tumors. Of the 30 endodermal sinus (yolk sac) tumors 29 were shown to be aneuploid, whereas the remaining tumor which exhibited the recently described primitive intestinal or enteric pattern was diploid and may thus be considered a neoplasm showing a somewhat higher degree of differentiation as compared to tumors showing the other histologic patterns of endodermal sinus (yolk sac) tumors.
abstract_ja: 卵黄嚢（内胚葉洞）腫瘍30例のパラフィン切片をフォイルゲン染色し、画像解析システムmicroTICASを用いたDNA細胞計測により核DNA量（倍数性）を評価した。症例の内訳は卵巣20例、精巣8例、仙尾部1例、縦隔1例であった。30例中29例は異数体であった。残る1例は、近年報告された原始腸管型あるいは腸型の組織パターンを示し、二倍体であった。この腫瘍は、他の組織パターンを示す卵黄嚢腫瘍と比べてより高度な分化を示す新生物と考えられる。
